verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a separate sandbox endpoint for its MCP server (mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz) alongside the production one, so a sandbox environment exists for agent testing. The evidence is a single parenthetical mention, though, with no detail on sandbox wallets, test funds, or data isolation from production. missing for 10: documentation of sandbox scope beyond the MCP endpoint (sandbox REST API, test keys, test wallets or funds), explicit guarantees that sandbox activity is isolated from production data and real settlement, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
